$comment: Routes fold:check measures (visual-direction § 1.3, scripts/fold-check.mjs): every top-level band <= maxBand (830 at 1470 x 830, 1700 at 390), and, where a viewport states its nav, every [data-fold-hero] + nav <= its height (the hero ends above the fold at 1470; at 390 only the band rule applies). A measurement inside data-fold-exempt is reported with its reason, never failed. Each family adds its specimen route. /case-studies is measured too: its card list is the one exempt band (an index list, CaseStudyIndex states why), so its hero and close are still held to the fold. /design/service-page/stress renders every StoryBlock variant in the band its job is given, so a template change that pushes any variant past the fold fails here, not on the page that first carries it.
